mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 3% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth above 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with FEDFUNDS < 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of increasing housing starts (HOUST) and rising retail sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with joint increasing HOUST and RSAFS.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 2% MoM signals strengthening supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of months with INDPRO growth above 2%.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2%) signals a benign monetary environment, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with CPIAUCSL < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between increasing payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decreasing unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with joint increasing PAYEMS and decreasing UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: during a mid-cycle expansion, a quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 2.5% YoY signals sustained economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth above 2.5% during mid-cycle expansions.
